scope: A convenience sample merged from two AI-assisted surveys; not a systematic review or a count of the field. Broad catalogue entries are bibliographic matches, not full-text-verified conclusions.

exclusions.reason: Withdrawn by the author; excluded from catalogue and counts.

notes: The 241-record broad survey contains one withdrawn paper: 240 retained.
The focused survey contributes 10 additional records after deduplication; two historical speech references are added from ISCA Archive.
2607.26159 supersedes a different withdrawn paper and is retained.
2502.17521 was rejected for a title mismatch in the earlier survey; the focused survey uses the verified EMNLP proceedings record instead.
Dates are arXiv first-submission months or proceedings years, not inferred conference acceptance.
Topics in the broad catalogue are title-keyword navigation aids; featured reading notes use editorial categorization.
